def _rename_serial_sequence(schema_editor, table_name, new_name):
    with schema_editor.connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute(
            '''
            SELECT namespace.nspname, sequence.relname
            FROM pg_class AS sequence
            JOIN pg_namespace AS namespace
              ON namespace.oid = sequence.relnamespace
            WHERE sequence.oid = pg_get_serial_sequence(%s, 'id')::regclass
            ''',
            [table_name],
        )
        sequence = cursor.fetchone()

    if sequence is None:
        return

    schema_name, current_name = sequence
    if current_name == new_name:
        return

    schema_editor.execute(
        'ALTER SEQUENCE {sequence} RENAME TO {new}'.format(
            sequence='{}.{}'.format(
                schema_editor.quote_name(schema_name),
                schema_editor.quote_name(current_name),
            ),
            new=schema_editor.quote_name(new_name),
        )
    )

    PortalProxy = apps.get_model('sojourner', 'PortalProxy')

    cluster_ids = list(
        Cluster.objects.order_by('pk').values_list('pk', flat=True)
    )
    AddressPool.objects.bulk_create(
        [
            AddressPool(cluster_id=cluster_id, name=DEFAULT_POOL_NAME)
            for cluster_id in cluster_ids
        ],
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    )
    default_pool_ids = dict(
        AddressPool.objects
        .filter(name=DEFAULT_POOL_NAME)
        .values_list('cluster_id', 'pk')
    )

    for cluster_id, pool_id in default_pool_ids.items():
        Address.objects.filter(
            cluster_id=cluster_id
        ).update(address_pool_id=pool_id)
        Portal.objects.filter(
            stack__cluster_id=cluster_id,
            direction='external',
        ).update(address_pool_id=pool_id)

    addresses = {
        (cluster_id, ipv4): address_id
        for address_id, cluster_id, ipv4 in Address.objects.values_list(
            'pk', 'cluster_id', 'ipv4'
        )
    }
    external_proxies = list(
        PortalProxy.objects
        .filter(portal__direction='external')
        .exclude(ipv4__isnull=True)
        .values_list('pk', 'portal__stack__cluster_id', 'ipv4')
    )
    missing_addresses = {
        (cluster_id, ipv4)
        for _, cluster_id, ipv4 in external_proxies
        if (cluster_id, ipv4) not in addresses
    }
    Address.objects.bulk_create(
        [
            Address(
                cluster_id=cluster_id,
                address_pool_id=default_pool_ids[cluster_id],
                ipv4=ipv4,
            )
            for cluster_id, ipv4 in sorted(missing_addresses)
        ],
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    )
    if missing_addresses:
        addresses.update({
            (cluster_id, ipv4): address_id
            for address_id, cluster_id, ipv4 in Address.objects
            .filter(cluster_id__in={item[0] for item in missing_addresses})
            .values_list('pk', 'cluster_id', 'ipv4')
        })

    proxy_ids = [proxy_id for proxy_id, _, _ in external_proxies]
    proxies_by_id = {
        proxy.pk: proxy
        for proxy in PortalProxy.objects.filter(pk__in=proxy_ids)
    }
    proxies_to_update = []
    for proxy_id, cluster_id, ipv4 in external_proxies:
        proxy = proxies_by_id[proxy_id]
        proxy.address_id = addresses[(cluster_id, ipv4)]
        proxies_to_update.append(proxy)
    if proxies_to_update:

            proxies_to_update,

        PortalProxy.objects

        .select_related('address')
    )

    if proxies:
        PortalProxy.objects.bulk_update(
            proxies,
            ['ipv4'],
            batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        )
